# Rule 5 — Metagaming and metacomms
Do not use information your character could not reasonably know. This includes information from Discord, streams, dead chat, adminhelps, observing, ghost roles, or another character you played.
Do not share round information through out-of-game communication while the round is active. This includes telling friends where you are, who the antagonist is, what security is doing, or where important items are.
You may talk with friends outside the game, but you must not use those conversations to gain an in-round advantage.
Keep each character’s knowledge separate. Your new character should not remember events, secrets, or antagonist identities learned by a previous character in the same round.
